# Summary
- What does this change do and why?
- Link related issues. Example: Closes #123

# Changes
- Bullet the key changes (files, pages, behaviors).

# How to Test
- Build: `jekyll build`
- Serve: `jekyll serve --baseurl ''` and visit `http://localhost:4000/`
- Verify affected pages (e.g., `about/`, `gallery/`, `journal/`).

# Screenshots
- If UI-visible, include before/after screenshots or GIFs.

# Checklist
- [ ] No changes committed under `_site/`
- [ ] Links use `{{ site.baseurl }}`/`{{ site.url }}` (no hardcoded absolute paths)
- [ ] Updated docs (`README.md` or `AGENTS.md`) as needed
- [ ] Noted any `_config.yml` updates in this PR description
